deltas.title: EBS 라디오 입이 트이는 영어 - 10.9 Plays
deltas.vocab:
fascinating: 매력적인, 신기한
up close: 코 앞에서
immerse in: 몰두하다
runny nose: 콧물
burst into tears: 갑자기 울음을 터뜨리다
get caught up in: ~에 휘말리다
can't remember: 기억이 안난다
a big round of applause: 큰 박수
for the first time in a while: 오랫만에
deltas.sentences:
I burst into tears.
I got so caught up in the actors' performances.
I can't remember the last time I cried so much.
I gave them a big round of applause.
I went to see a play for the first time in a while.
